about.en: Gold xStock (GLDx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on SPDR Gold Shares (GLD), issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by GLD shares held with qualified custodians and tracks the ETF price on-chain on Solana (Xsv9hRk1z5ystj9MhnA7Lq4vjSsLwzL2nxrwmwtD3re), Ethereum, BNB Chain and Arbitrum (0x2380f2673c640fb67e2d6b55b44c62f0e0e69da9) and other networks. It gives a claim to the value of the ETF, not to physical gold. xStocks are offered to non-US investors.
